# Ice floe, 8 m long: ice body, snow cap, drifts. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Ice --base-color 0.353 0.725 0.659 --no-slot
material new Snow --base-color 0.769 0.941 0.761 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Body --size 1 --location 0 0 -0.24
scale 8 1.4 0.36
apply --scale
material assign Ice
active Body
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
scale 0.9500 0.85 1
select all
subdivide --cuts 2
select vert where "pos.z < -0.1"
randomize --amount 0.04 --seed 8
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.z > 0.9 || normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name Cap --size 1 --location 0 -0.02 -0.04
scale 8.06 1.48 0.08
apply --scale
material assign Snow
active Cap
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --name Drift0 --segments 6 --rings 3 --radius 0.5 --location -3.03 0.56 0
scale 0.69 0.26 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Snow
active Drift0
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < -0.01"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --name Drift1 --segments 6 --rings 3 --radius 0.5 --location -0.50 0.56 0
scale 0.61 0.26 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Snow
active Drift1
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < -0.01"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh uv-sphere --name Drift2 --segments 6 --rings 3 --radius 0.5 --location 2.11 0.56 0
scale 0.47 0.26 0.12
apply --scale
material assign Snow
active Drift2
mode edit
select face where "pos.z < -0.01"
delete only-faces
mode object
select all
active Cap
join
rename Cap Floe
shade flat
export floe8.glb
